scenes.scenario: A family member wants to change the contact number on their own file
scenes.lead: In this call, a family member wants to update their own contact details.

lines.text: Thank you for calling. My name is Ana. How may I help you today?
Hi. I would like to change the phone number you have on my file.
I'm happy to help with that. First I need to verify who I'm speaking with. May I have your full name and your reference, please?
Of course. It's Carla Reyes, and the reference is in my last email.
Thank you, Carla. That matches our record. What is the new number?
It's my new mobile. I'll read it out.
Thank you. Let me read it back to make sure it's correct. I've updated your file and added a note about the change. Is there anything else I can help with?

items.say: Verified who she was before changing anything.
Read the new detail back to confirm it.
Added a note about the change.

title: Worked example: a form returned twice
label: WORKED EXAMPLE  |  ELEVATE LEARN
introSay: Worked example. A form returned twice.

scenes.scenario: A family member's form has come back to them twice
scenes.lead: In this call, a family member is frustrated that a form they sent has come back twice.

lines.text: I have sent this form twice and it keeps coming back to me!
I'm sorry that has happened twice. Let me make sure I understand. You sent the form, and it was returned each time. Is that right?
Yes, and nobody tells me what is missing.
That would frustrate anyone. Let me check the notes on your file, so you don't have to explain it all again.

Once I confirm what is missing, I'll explain how to send it and what to expect. I'll also note on your file that you've already sent it twice, so the next person doesn't ask you to start over. I can't promise a processing time until it's confirmed.

items.say: Checked that she understood the problem correctly.
Reviewed the notes, so the caller did not repeat everything.
And made no promise about a time that was not confirmed.

title: Worked example: a request for a supervisor
label: WORKED EXAMPLE  |  ELEVATE LEARN
introSay: Worked example. A request for a supervisor.

scenes.scenario: A family member missed a deadline and wants someone to review it
scenes.lead: In this call, a family member asks to speak with a supervisor.

lines.text: I would like to speak with a supervisor.
Of course. I'll help you with that. If you're comfortable, could you tell me briefly what it's about, so I can pass it along?
I missed a deadline by one day, and I was told no exception is possible.
Thank you for explaining. I understand you would like someone to review that. I'll follow our process to connect you with a supervisor, and I'll share your summary so you don't have to repeat it.
I'll check how the process works and tell you the next step. I don't want to give you a wait time that I can't confirm.

items.say: Passed the summary on, so the caller did not repeat it.
And did not invent a wait time.
